passes.raw: My dog Gamble is an Australian shepherd. I like to gamble and play poker with cards. My son O and I watched cars. Lightning McQueen raced past Mater and Flo. Lightning lit the sky, and water began to flow. Bluey and Bingo played with Chilean Bandit. We ate chili and played bingo after the show. I said a bandit stole the cards. This Linux software project is called Transcrust. Nell and I talked about the next school day.
